verdict.rationale: Simular documents a real API (POST /v1/agents/message, POST /v1/agents/approve, a Python SDK, and an MCP server), so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive or try-it-out reference with runnable request examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The runnable community automation scripts and the llms.txt index are adjacent features, not an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit.
